title: Existence of coefficient numerator map
statement: For a scheme X, an invertible module L, a homogeneous section s of positive degree d, and an open U on which its restriction is a free generator, there exists a coefficient function on the homogeneous localization satisfying the displayed numerator equation for every exponent and homogeneous numerator.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (local quotient construction and comparison) and 01NK (different positive degrees)

proof.text: Use exists_sectionRing_veronese_fraction_equiv to identify the homogeneous localization with the section-fraction presentation for M = L.tensorPow d and the structure module. Its formula identifies each xi/s^n with the exponent-transported numerator, with the inverse left unitor inserting the structure-module tensor factor. This formula uniquely determines the equivalence on all fractions.

Rewrite the free-generator hypothesis using homOfGlobalSection_app_one. Apply exists_sectionFraction_restriction_map to M, the structure module, s.val d, and U. Compose this additive restriction-and-division map with the Veronese equivalence and unitSectionsEquiv U inverse to obtain the coefficient function c. Its tensor formula uniquely determines the map because tensoring with each power of the free generator is bijective.

Prove ring_power_of by induction on n using pow_succ prime, DirectSum.of_mul_of, tensorPowMulIso, and the tensor-section formulas. The zero case is the graded unit. In the successor case the exponent cast is handled by a dependent equality of graded monoid elements. Extract the degree n*d component to obtain veroneseIso_power; naturality then gives the same identity after restriction to U.

Apply the section-fraction restriction tensor formula to the Veronese image of xi. Apply the left unitor on U, turning tensoring with the structure-module section into scalar multiplication. Naturality moves restriction through the numerator transport; the inverse left unitor cancels with the left unitor. The power identity identifies the transported denominator with tensorPowSectionOne. Finally injectivity of the tensor-power isomorphism yields the exact numerator equation. This works for n=0 and empty U without additional hypotheses; positive degree is not used.

proof_origin.place: Reuse of the canonical fraction restriction map of Lemma 01PW and the Veronese presentation of Tag 0B5L; tensor comparison helpers follow the proved SectionRingLocalizationBijective argument.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_sectionRing_coefficient_numerator
    (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) (hd : 0 < d) (U : X.Opens)
    (hs : IsFreeGenerator ((L.tensorPow d).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (s.val d))) :
    ∃ c : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val → Γ(X, U),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
        c (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
            ξ.val ξ.property) •
          (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
            ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) =
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
          (ξ.val (n • d))
